title: digitaria hispida
intro: Digitaria hispida, commonly known as finger grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the reduction of inflammation and the improvement of digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders. Bioactive constituents of Digitaria hispida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
